# Sarfraz Autos – Motorcycle Spare Parts & Crown Wholesale Distributor

> Official distributor and wholesale supplier of genuine Crown motorcycle spare parts, engine components, and overhaul kits based in Karachi, Pakistan. Serving retail riders, mechanics, and wholesale dealers nationwide.

## Company Overview
- **Brand Name**: Sarfraz Autos
- **Headquarters**: Taj Mahal Market, M.A. Jinnah Road, Saddar, Karachi, Sindh 74200, Pakistan
- **Core Specialization**: Genuine Crown motorcycle parts, OEM replacement components, master cartons, wholesale dealer distribution, and nationwide courier/bilty delivery.
- **Phone / WhatsApp**: +92 333 1285556
- **Operating Hours**: Monday – Saturday, 09:00 AM – 07:00 PM (PKT)
- **Supported Payment Methods**: Cash on Delivery (COD), Direct Bank Transfer (IBFT / Raast), EasyPaisa, JazzCash.

## Supported Motorcycle Models
- **Honda**: CD 70, CD 70 Dream, CG 125, CG 125 Special Edition, Pridor (100cc), CB 150F
- **Yamaha**: YBR 125, YBR 125G, YB 125Z, YB 125Z-DX
- **Suzuki**: GS 150, GS 150SE, GR 150, GD 110, GD 110S
- **Chinese / Local Variants**: United 70/100/125, Super Power, Super Star, Unique, Hi-Speed, Crown, Road Prince

## Key Product Categories
- **Engine Components**: Cylinder blocks, pistons & rings, crankshafts, camshafts, rocker arms, timing chains, valves & valve guides, engine gasket sets.
- **Transmission & Clutch**: Clutch plates, pressure plates, clutch hub & housing, primary gears, gear shift forks.
- **Carburetors & Fuel System**: Carburetors (CD70, CG125, YBR, GS150), repair kits, fuel petcock valves, fuel filters, fuel tanks.
- **Suspension & Wheels**: Front fork assemblies, rear shock absorbers, wheel drums (front & rear), brake shoes, wheel hubs, sprockets & chains.
- **Electrical & Lighting**: Headlights, tail lights, turn signals (indicators), CDI units, ignition coils, wiring harnesses, rectifiers.
- **Body & Hardware**: Side covers (tappas), mudguards/fenders, handles, cables (clutch, throttle, brake, meter).

## Wholesale & Dealer Program
- **Master Carton Packaging**: Factory-sealed export quality master cartons for regional retail shops and wholesalers.
- **Trade Schemes**: Buy X + Get Y promotional schemes directly from Crown and authorized manufacturers.
- **Dealer Accounts**: Special assigned trade discounts (e.g., 5% to 15% off wholesale list prices) approved by admin.
- **Nationwide Freight**: Daily dock dispatch via TCS, Leopards, and freight cargo / bilty across Karachi, Lahore, Faisalabad, Rawalpindi, Islamabad, Multan, Sukkur, Hyderabad, and Peshawar.
